scope: Unsigned deposit/reset/approval encoding and explicit next-step gas simulation only; actual funding remains incomplete.

domain.coverage: Exact vectors across 3 chains, both account markets, native/ERC20, reset and exact approval, immutable calls, uint256 precision, unsupported and malformed routes/addresses/metadata/amounts/allowances.

mock_rpc_repository.coverage: Exact unsigned pending calls; large integers, ceil20%, native value+fee, approval/reset scope, invalid amounts, pending/changed nonce, nonce bound, gas price/quantity, block limit/reorg/time, safe simulation error without result, scope-loss stops and broadcast/sign method refusal.

controller.coverage: Explicit restored non-signing EOA, no new wallet, busy dedup, stale quote retention/retry, earliest wallet/quote/block deadline, invalid time, tampered wallet/query/amount/calldata/value/kind/fees, identity changes, stop and transport disposal/late response.

widgets.coverage: en/zh320 text1.5 and landscape; next-step review, exact approval/reset/native distinctions, fee display, input drift, stale failure/retry retention, offscreen retention, wallet clearing, native Max disabled, stop/route exit and zero wallet signing/creation.

acceptance_evidence.regression: All 1833 tests pass, including 342 funding tests. Widget fixture uses an injected gas repository; no production RPC simulation.

build_notes: Release succeeds with existing third-party Kotlin migration/compatibility notices. APK not installed.
native_testing: Not performed at user request. No device tools, installation or real account integration; pending items in ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux lacks macOS/Xcode, not built or tested.
remaining: Actual wallet chain switch, approval/deposit signing and submission, receipts, platform credit and durable unknown-result recovery.
User/platform residual deposit limits require website private BAPI authentication unavailable in this phase; native Max remains disabled.
Gas reserve covers current step only and is a changing legacy gas-price snapshot, not final fees or execution evidence.
Enable-trading/self-EOA authorization, full subaccounts/transfers, full Portfolio, Chase and ordinary/dedicated-close BBO remain incomplete. Private BAPI statistics/TWAP skipped by user decision.
